title: outbox-row
description: One durable outbox row (SCOPE.md section 4, B18-5): append-only JSONL, atomic writes (temp+rename with completeness marker), idempotent replay keyed on outbox_id, visible pending/failed state. NOT a scheduler: no cross-device ordering, no background execution, no retry policy, no exactly-once. Instance rows land only under ~/.sutra-native/outbox/ — never in the plugin package or sutra/os/native/schemas/. The row is a self-contained artifact: no conversational carry. Evolution is additive-only.

schema_version.description: Schema version of this row. All rows carry schema_version; evolution is additive-only.

outbox_id.description: THE stable idempotency key for this row — replay of the same outbox_id is a no-op. Uniquely identifies the queued ask across replays.

ts_queued.description: Timestamp (ISO 8601) when the ask was queued into the outbox.

ask_text.description: The ask, verbatim, as a self-contained artifact — the row carries everything needed for local replay; no conversational carry.

state.description: Visible row state: pending (queued, not yet replayed), replayed (consumed by a replay), failed (replay attempted and failed; visible, no retry policy in v1).

ts_resolved.description: Timestamp (ISO 8601) when the row left pending (replayed or failed). Null while pending.

replay_ref.description: Reference to the replay/run that consumed this row. Null until a replay resolves it.
